canada.title: Australia’s inaugural Ambassador for First Nations People visits Canada
canada.summary: Justin Mohamed, the inaugural ambassador for First Nations People in Australia visits Canada and sits down Face to Face.

canada.title: Tensions between PM, Quebec premier continue to flare in new tiff over U.S. relations
canada.summary: Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon sent letters to U.S. elected officials, as part of his intention to negotiate directly with American states. The move appeared to irritate Prime Minister Mark Carney, who said, "in a negotiation, it's always a good idea to have a single negotiator."

canada.title: RCMP search suspended for missing canoeist off Vancouver Island while community-led search continues
canada.summary: A police search for missing canoeist James "Dakota" Smith off northern Vancouver Island has been suspended as RCMP say challenging weather has made the chance of his survival unlikely. The Ma’amtagila Tribe Society is continuing their search for Smith and are calling for a coordinated, resourced search operation.

canada.title: Irving Oil, Grant Enterprises plead guilty to environment charges stemming from Woodstock diesel spill
canada.summary: Irving Oil Ltd. and Grant Enterprises 1984 Ltd. have pleaded guilty in provincial court to charges under the Clean Environment Act due to a 200,000-plus-litre diesel spill in Woodstock.

canada.title: CAO institutes discretionary spending freeze in CBRM to avoid cuts

canada.title: Descendants say reviving Japanese Canadian veterans' Legion rights historical wrong
canada.summary: After internment forced its closure, a Legion that served Japanese Canadian veterans of the First World War is being resurrected.

canada.title: Stellantis plant sale: New employment program aims to help laid-off Brampton workers
canada.summary: With thousands of Brampton autoworkers facing an uncertain future, a new regional initiative is fast-tracking pathways into logistics and manufacturing across the Pearson Economic Zone.

canada.title: N.S. group apologizes for including woman convicted in a brutal killing on a panel
canada.summary: The Elizabeth Fry Society of Mainland Nova Scotia is apologizing after it hosted a panel discussion on violence that featured Marissa Shephard. Shephard was sentenced to 12 years in jail after she pleaded guilty to manslaughter and arson in the death of Baylee Wylie.

canada.title: N.W.T. allocation for nominee program increases, 5th intake draw added
canada.summary: The N.W.T. government says another expression of interest draw has been scheduled for Nov. 18, after Ottawa added another 50 spots to its nominee program allocation for this year.

canada.title: Calgary's 4-year budget proposes 15% property tax hike, rising water rates
canada.summary: City administration released the 2027-2030 budget to the public on Tuesday, and it proposes a double-digit property tax increase to catch up with a growing population and aging infrastructure.
